title: Vibrant Spring Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A romantic and flavorful Algerian dish featuring lamb, truffle oil, and pickles, perfect for a spring evening. This paleo-friendly recipe is a unique blend of winey and springy flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine or Dutch oven, and simmer the lamb mixture for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the truffle oil and pickled turnips, and continue to simmer the mixture for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the lamb tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
